create_logger: create a logger with file and console handlers using create_logger(filepath, rank)
create_log_formatter: create a LogFormatter instance that adds elapsed time to log messages
format_log_record: format a log record with level name, timestamp, and elapsed seconds using LogFormatter.format
reset_logger_time: reset the logger elapsed time counter by calling logger.reset_time()
review_create_logger: review the create_logger function to understand file and console handler setup
